about: Lays its entries out in columns, as a root holding items that may span more than one of them.

alignment.about: Where an entry sits in a row taller than it is: a short entry beside one that runs to a second line.
alignment.title: Alignment

counts.about: Every count, each drawing that many equal columns and wrapping the twelve entries into them.
counts.title: Counts

distribution.about: How the columns share the room along the row. The columns of every measure fill the grid, so the shares read alike until a theme narrows the tracks.
distribution.title: Distribution

filled.about: Every measure that keeps the columns a short row leaves empty, so the six entries hold their measure rather than stretching across the row.
filled.title: Filled

fitted.about: Every measure that draws as many columns as there is room for and wraps the rest, which is the whole of the grid's responsiveness.
fitted.title: Fitted

flow.about: Which way the entries are placed: along the rows, down the columns, or along the rows with a later entry pulled back into a hole an earlier one left.
flow.title: Flow

gaps.about: Every gap of the scale, between three columns of entries.
gaps.title: Gaps

note: A note that runs on to a second line in its column

spans.about: Every span an entry can take in a grid of twelve, drawn on the first entry with the rest a column wide.
spans.title: Spans

title: Grid
